resources.string: Choose the model files to use
This app has no internet access. Download the model files you want with your browser, then choose each file here. Files are used where they are stored – nothing is copied.
Checksum does not match the official file – it may be corrupt or a different version
The selected file is named %1$s but %2$s was expected. Make sure it is the right model.
Android did not allow permanent access to this file, so it may stop working after a restart. Try choosing it from another location (e.g. Downloads).

Lynx Voice Input is an unofficial, modified version of FUTO Voice Input (https://voiceinput.futo.org), Copyright FUTO, used under the FUTO Source First License 1.1 (non-commercial use). It is not affiliated with or endorsed by FUTO. Modifications: no network access, no in-app billing, update checking or crash reporting (a link to support FUTO is kept), and model files are chosen from device storage instead of being downloaded.
Last attempt to use it failed: %1$s

Lynx Voice Input is based on FUTO Voice Input, which FUTO develops and which is free for personal, non-commercial use. If you find it useful, please consider supporting FUTO. The button opens FUTO\'s payment page in your web browser. This app has no internet access itself and sends nothing.
